caseNameFull: E. W. Blancett v. State of New Mexico
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of New Mexico.
attorneys: Mr. A. B. Renehan for plaintiff in error., Mr. O. O. Askren, Mr. Harry S. Bowman and Mr. N. D. Meyer for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
